annotations.title: RiskModels Macro and Sector ETF Factor Returns

description: Use when you need macro factor return series (inflation, term spread, short rates, credit, oil, gold, the dollar, volatility, bitcoin, VIX) or the trailing returns of SPY and the 11 GICS sector SPDR ETFs. Not for a stock's correlation with those factors (use riskmodels_get_macro_correlation) or one ETF's daily return series (use riskmodels_get_returns). kind macro returns daily total returns over a date range (GET /macro-factors); kind sector_etf returns closing price and trailing 1, 21, 63 and 252-day total returns on one date (GET /etf/factor-returns). End-of-day data, refreshed after each US market close. Price: $0.005 per call (macro) or $0.02 per call (sector_etf).

end.description: kind macro only: last date, inclusive (default today), format YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-06-30

factors.description: kind macro only: comma-separated keys from inflation, term_spread, short_rates, credit, oil, gold, usd, volatility, bitcoin, vix_spot, e.g. "oil,gold,usd" (default all ten)

kind.description: macro: daily macro factor returns over a range; sector_etf: SPY and sector SPDR returns on one date, e.g. macro

sleeve.description: kind sector_etf only: market (SPY), sector (11 sector SPDRs) or all, e.g. sector (default all)

start.description: kind macro only: first date, inclusive (default five years before end), format YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2021-01-04

teo.description: kind sector_etf only: observation date (default latest), format YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-06-30

tickers.description: kind sector_etf only: comma-separated subset of SPY, XLE, XLB, XLI, XLY, XLP, XLV, XLF, XLK, XLC, XLU, XLRE, e.g. "XLK,XLF"
